source: live Dialog PDF refusal on the canned onboarding welcome
note: A real new customer stores the canned onboarding welcome as the first vacation-app turn. That turn must be the fixed opener the Dialog renderer already accepts: replyProducer vacation-app-onboarding-opener, fixedOpener true, and null latencyMs, sessionE2eMs, and jevScoreDraft. Do not loosen the renderer. An app turn that is not that opener must still come from vacation-app-reply-rules. Do not change the terms text customers see.

assertions.note: The stamped canned welcome is turn 1 and passes assertLiveTranscript. The same welcome without replyProducer vacation-app-onboarding-opener still refuses with: turn 1 app text did not come from vacation-app-reply-rules.
